answer: Each additional ongoing medical condition (MHONGO) is associated with a 16.64% increase in the odds of higher COVID-19 severity (odds ratio 1.1664, 95% CI 0.8644–1.5738), as estimated by a proportional-odds ordinal regression of worst (max) AESEV (1–4) for the AEPT=='COVID-19' event on the per-subject count of MHONGO=='Yes' conditions, adjusted for BCG vaccination status (TRTGRP) and the patient interaction variables patients_seen and expect_interact (n=148). A 3-level sensitivity model (3+4 collapsed) gives 15.92% (OR 1.1592), so the answer is robust at ~16%.
